title: Certificate: code/plans.py
signature: candidates(request, profile, options, ledger, capacity, streams, oneoffs, config) -> list[Candidate]
guarantees: Families: one full_payment (from the request's full_payment option), one per installment option (dates = first + k*frequency, amounts = payment_amount), partial_payment iff I5 holds, wait iff earliest_full_day is not null.
safe computed by subtracting cumulative payments from balance and checking >= floor on every day 0..90.
total_paid = total_payable_amount for option-backed candidates, else requested_amount.

Spending-change variants (config.spending_changes) generated only if no change-free candidate is both safe and on time; subsets in increasing size ordered by event_id, max 3; each variant re-runs ledger.forecast on the changed streams; amount_safe_to_pay is NOT recomputed.
sort_key filled per spec §5; eligible/rejection_reasons filled by filters 1-2 (rank may re-check).
